about: The text the server puts at each JSON pointer of the vendored yeet-tools.json (tool-contract.mjs applies "contract" at load) and the card report sentences. In this repository every original is the neutral text; the wording YEET deploys is not part of it.

/$defs/card_build/description.neutral: Set by the card only: the build of the card that makes this call.
/$defs/card_build/description.original: Set by the card only: the build of the card that makes this call.

/$defs/guidance/description.neutral: Text for the assistant about this result; the card does not read it.
/$defs/guidance/description.original: Text for the assistant about this result; the card does not read it.

/$defs/overview/properties/referral_open.neutral: true: the win code was never asked.
/$defs/overview/properties/referral_open.original: true: the win code was never asked.

/$defs/terms_statement/properties/url/de.neutral: The document or section this statement refers to.
/$defs/terms_statement/properties/url/de.original: The document or section this statement refers to.

/tools/daily_spin/description.neutral: Card only: uses the next available daily or bonus spin and awards its XP and stamp.
/tools/daily_spin/description.original: Card only: uses the next available daily or bonus spin and awards its XP and stamp.

/tools/lucky_wheel/description.neutral: Shows today's lucky wheel card: up to five randomly picked coins and the YEET offer for the coin it lands on.
/tools/lucky_wheel/description.original: Shows today's lucky wheel card: up to five randomly picked coins and the YEET offer for the coin it lands on.

/tools/skeet_propose/description.neutral: Quotes a SKEET (sell) of a percent of 1-5 held coins back to USDC and shows the SKEET card; it sells nothing.
/tools/skeet_propose/description.original: Quotes a SKEET (sell) of a percent of 1-5 held coins back to USDC and shows the SKEET card; it sells nothing.

/tools/trade_status/description.neutral: Returns the live status of a trade and what was received.
/tools/trade_status/description.original: Returns the live status of a trade and what was received.

/tools/yeet_accept_terms/description.neutral: Records the person's acceptance of the current YEET terms version.
/tools/yeet_accept_terms/description.original: Records the person's acceptance of the current YEET terms version.

/tools/yeet_checkin/description.neutral: Shows the daily check-in card: the wheel, the streak and the stamps.
/tools/yeet_checkin/description.original: Shows the daily check-in card: the wheel, the streak and the stamps.

/tools/yeet_coin/description.neutral: Shows the coin card for one coin: its USD price, its change over 1, 6 and 24 hours, the person's holding and the basket limits.
/tools/yeet_coin/description.original: Shows the coin card for one coin: its USD price, its change over 1, 6 and 24 hours, the person's holding and the basket limits.

/tools/yeet_coin/outputSchema/properties.neutral: Third-party text about the coin from its listing on a market data site: the coin's own project's claims, not YEET's.
/tools/yeet_coin/outputSchema/properties.original: Third-party text about the coin from its listing on a market data site: the coin's own project's claims, not YEET's.

/tools/yeet_coin/outputSchema/properties.neutral: The coin's own website as a market data site lists it (third-party), or null; the card does not show it.
/tools/yeet_coin/outputSchema/properties.original: The coin's own website as a market data site lists it (third-party), or null; the card does not show it.

/tools/yeet_coin/outputSchema/properties.neutral: The coin's profile on X as a market data site lists it (third-party), or null; the card does not show it.
/tools/yeet_coin/outputSchema/properties.original: The coin's profile on X as a market data site lists it (third-party), or null; the card does not show it.

/tools/yeet_coins/description.neutral: Lists every tradable coin with its USD price, its percent change over 1, 6 and 24 hours, and the trade limits.
/tools/yeet_coins/description.original: Lists every tradable coin with its USD price, its percent change over 1, 6 and 24 hours, and the trade limits.

/tools/yeet_fund/description.neutral: Shows the Add funds card, on the crypto or card view when method is given, otherwise with both choices.
/tools/yeet_fund/description.original: Shows the Add funds card, on the crypto or card view when method is given, otherwise with both choices.

/tools/yeet_home/description.neutral: Shows whether the person's YEET account is ready to trade, their USDC and their XP.
/tools/yeet_home/description.original: Shows whether the person's YEET account is ready to trade, their USDC and their XP.

/tools/yeet_leaderboard/description.neutral: Shows a YEET leaderboard (xp, winners, best_trade, losers or coins) for a time window, with the person's place.
/tools/yeet_leaderboard/description.original: Shows a YEET leaderboard (xp, winners, best_trade, losers or coins) for a time window, with the person's place.

/tools/yeet_overview/description.neutral: Shows the welcome card with the person's USDC, XP, tier, streak, daily check-in state and next actions.
/tools/yeet_overview/description.original: Shows the welcome card with the person's USDC, XP, tier, streak, daily check-in state and next actions.

/tools/yeet_overview/inputSchema/propert.neutral: The tools version this tool list was built for.
/tools/yeet_overview/inputSchema/propert.original: The tools version this tool list was built for.

/tools/yeet_portfolio/description.neutral: Shows the coins and USDC the person holds on YEET, with values.
/tools/yeet_portfolio/description.original: Shows the coins and USDC the person holds on YEET, with values.

/tools/yeet_profile/description.neutral: Returns the person's YEET display name, XP, tier and streak.
/tools/yeet_profile/description.original: Returns the person's YEET display name, XP, tier and streak.

/tools/yeet_propose/description.neutral: Quotes a YEET (buy) basket that spends USDC on 1-5 coins split by whole-number parts and shows the basket card; it buys nothing.
/tools/yeet_propose/description.original: Quotes a YEET (buy) basket that spends USDC on 1-5 coins split by whole-number parts and shows the basket card; it buys nothing.

/tools/yeet_quote/description.neutral: Refreshes an existing YEET or SKEET quote by proposal_id and saves it as a new revision; it trades nothing.
/tools/yeet_quote/description.original: Refreshes an existing YEET or SKEET quote by proposal_id and saves it as a new revision; it trades nothing.

/tools/yeet_referral/description.neutral: Shows the win code card: one input that starts with WIN, Apply and Skip.
/tools/yeet_referral/description.original: Shows the win code card: one input that starts with WIN, Apply and Skip.

/tools/yeet_set_username/description.neutral: Replaces the person's YEET display name.
/tools/yeet_set_username/description.original: Replaces the person's YEET display name.

/tools/yeet_terms/description.neutral: Returns the current YEET terms statements with their links and whether the person accepted this version.
/tools/yeet_terms/description.original: Returns the current YEET terms statements with their links and whether the person accepted this version.

/tools/yeet_how_it_works/description.neutral: Returns the security and wallet facts: who holds the keys, what YEET's server can and cannot do, and how the person exports their private key.
/tools/yeet_how_it_works/description.original: Returns the security and wallet facts: who holds the keys, what YEET's server can and cannot do, and how the person exports their private key.
